description:
FILED s473t6d member 4 (Opus, 2026-09-20, finished s493).  PRE-EXISTING; a
consequence of #1651, filed separately because the SYMPTOM is in the row baseline,
not in the file.

baselines/perl-suite-run.tsv already records the hang:
  op/gv.t  304/0  90/95  TIMEOUT  "#1651 -- THE HANG IS ATTRIBUTED: 135/56 DIFF ->
  TIMEOUT 67/24 at 0ea8d7e1 ... the blessed 135/56 is unreachable today".
baselines/perl-suite-fails.tsv still holds that unreachable run's 170 rows.

So the outcome of a companion run depends only on which LABEL the runner gives the
hang:
  * labelled TIMEOUT -> the tool prints `~ op/gv.t 51 new row(s) in a file that
    produced no comparable TAP -- noise, not a regression` and the run is clean;
  * labelled DIFF (the file reached its exit before the clock) -> the same 51 rows
    are counted as NEW ROW and the run reads NOT CLEAN.

MEASURED s493 (`--jobs 1 --timeout 180`, one invocation per side):
    companion batch run   op/gv.t  90/95  DIFF      -> 51 NEW ROW
    tree, file alone      op/gv.t  90/95  TIMEOUT   -> 51 rows called noise
    base (268d7e00)       op/gv.t  90/95  TIMEOUT   -> 51 rows called noise
The ROW SET is identical in all three; only the verdict label moves.
Logs: scratch/s473t6d/{companion-op.log,ab/tree-light.log,ab/base-light.log}.

FIX: either re-bless op/gv.t's 170 fail rows from a run that reproduces today's
90/95 (they are all failures that "always failed" -- the snapshot row says so), or
fix #1651 first and re-bless from a completing run.  Until then a reader cannot
tell a real gv.t regression from the label lottery.


=== LOOKED AT s494 (Fable) -- NOT the cheap re-spelling #1966 was ===
The 51 rows are not a spelling problem: they are the row set of a run that TIMES OUT at a different point than the blessed 135/56 run did, so making them comparable means either blessing 51 rows with a CAUSE each (a census job: they belong to #1651`s family) or fixing #1651`s hang first.  Left pending behind #1651; the label lottery (DIFF vs TIMEOUT decides whether the same 51 rows are noise or NEW) is a RUNNER question worth one line when #1651 is scheduled: a file whose SNAPSHOT row is TIMEOUT could have its rows treated as unverified whatever label today`s run gets.
subject: op/gv.t's blessed fail rows are from the unreachable 135/56 run, so a run the hang lets finish reports 51 phantom NEW ROWs
